objective.primary: Increase breakout probability through higher-recognition films/series, faster conflict, and a fully non-Globo YouTube lane.
objective.note: 70k likes on 100k views is a 70% like rate and remains an extraordinary stretch; retention, shares and comments remain leading indicators.

benchmark_basis.latest_synced_tiktok: 2026-10-11: O Auto da Compadecida led with 228 views, 20 likes and 10s average watch; Cidade dos Homens 197/9/3s; Os Penetras 2 182/9/6s.
benchmark_basis.latest_synced_instagram: 2026-10-11: Tropa de Elite 2 led with 195 views, 7 likes, 1 save and 10.448s average watch; Saltimbancos 174 views/4 likes/6.75s; Um Tio Quase Perfeito 172/3/5.886s.
benchmark_basis.latest_synced_facebook: 2026-10-11: Como Nossos Pais reached 1,135 views and 7 likes; O Filho Eterno 280; Cidade dos Homens 239.
benchmark_basis.historic_tiktok: Tô de Graça: 22,663 views, 2,780 likes, 25 comments, 57 shares, 68s average watch; Vai Que Cola repeatedly exceeded 5k-11k.
benchmark_basis.historic_instagram: Vai Que Cola: 1,271 views, 58 likes, 21.246s average watch, 78.2% 3s view rate.
benchmark_basis.historic_youtube: Vai Que Cola: 6,694 views, 308 likes, ~24s average watch. To avoid Globo blocking, Oct13 YouTube uses only non-Globo CC BY NickRewind/Nickelodeon sources via Wikimedia Commons.
benchmark_basis.strategy_change: No novelas in the Oct13 grid. TikTok/Instagram/Facebook focus on film and series scenes; YouTube is 100% non-Globo.
